# Project Flowchart Skill

Generates visual flowcharts for project workflows, tasks, and processes. Use to clarify and document iterative improvement cycles, feature integration, and maintenance routines.

## Example Prompts
- "Create flowchart for iterative improvement workflow."
- "Visualize feature integration process."
- "Show maintenance checklist flow."
